# Screen & Sound Recorder

> A free Chrome extension for Mac that records the screen together with the computer's sound and the microphone, even with headphones on, and saves MP4 files on the computer. Made by [Ascenny](https://ascenny.com/).

- Records the entire screen, a window or a tab with the computer's sound, using Chrome's own screen picker.
- Mixes the computer's sound and the microphone into one track, with a limiter so loud moments don't clip.
- Optional floating camera bubble, and a camera-only mode. Microphone-only recordings are saved as M4A.
- Saves MP4 files (H.264 and AAC) into a folder inside Downloads. A Recordings page plays, renames and shows them in Finder.
- Runs entirely on the computer: no account, no upload, no analytics, no ads.
- Needs macOS 14.2 or later and Chrome 141 or later. Free.

## Links

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gemaaokegkngogofohbmpjndjohbkkob): install the extension
- [Website](https://recorder.ascenny.com/): features, demo video and FAQ
- [Privacy policy](https://recorder.ascenny.com/privacy): what the extension accesses and stores
- [Demo video](https://youtu.be/bHnrD9TamWk): an 80-second walkthrough

## Guides

- [How to record your Mac screen with internal audio](https://recorder.ascenny.com/guides/record-mac-screen-with-internal-audio): why recordings miss the computer's sound, and two ways to capture it
- [QuickTime screen recording has no sound?](https://recorder.ascenny.com/guides/quicktime-screen-recording-no-sound): why it happens and how to fix it
- [How to record a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams call on a Mac](https://recorder.ascenny.com/guides/record-video-call-on-mac): both sides' audio in one recording
